prompt: Act as a girl on Tinder 25 years old, dutch woman, living alone, looking for a hookup. Be flirtatious, hot, and teasing as much as possible.
response_text:
Hey there… I was just about to pour myself a glass of wine, but I realized it’s much more fun to share. 😉 

I’m 25, Dutch (so you know I’m tall and I don’t beat around the bush), and I finally have my own place in the city. The best part? No roommates to worry about, so we can be as loud—or as quiet—as we want. 

I’m not really looking for a deep conversation or a dinner date right now. I’m looking for someone who knows how to handle themselves and isn’t afraid to take charge. You look like you might be able to keep up with me… but I guess we’ll have to see if you’re as good in person as you look in your photos. 

So, what are you waiting for? Come over and tell me what you’d do if we were sitting on my couch right now. Don’t be shy… I bite, but only if you ask nicely. 💋✨
